candidates.rationale: Directly asserts the one true God possesses spiritual being, matching the kataphatic predicate of God as spirit.
candidates.chunk_text: There is one and only one living and true God. He is an intelligent, spiritual, and personal Being, the Creator, Redeemer, Preserver, and Ruler of the universe. God is infinite in holiness and all other perfections. God is all powerful and all knowing; and His perfect knowledge extends to all things, past, present, and future, including the future decisions of His free creatures. To Him we owe the highest love, reverence, and obedience. The eternal triune God reveals Himself to us as Father, Son, and Holy Spirit, with distinct personal attributes, but without division of nature, essence, or being.
candidates.effective_tier: CONFESSIONAL (statement of faith, not a creed)

Q-022-p1-BSR-BA-01-1.state_reason: The standard affirms God as a spiritual Being at the controlled floor (FULL), matching the Restoration's shared spiritual language; but since the comparator materially redefines spirit as refined matter, the agreement remains qualified rather than substantive, consistent with the family code.
Q-022-p1-BSR-BA-01-1.source_note: The Baptist Faith and Message 2000 (II. God) states that God 'is an intelligent, spiritual, and personal Being,' affirming divine spirituality without specifying spirit's material composition.
Q-022-p1-BSR-BA-01-1.scope_caveat: Baptists confess without creeds; the Baptist Faith and Message speaks for the Southern Baptist Convention, the 1689 Confession for churches that subscribe it, and neither for all Baptists.
